versions.subject: Fix all the rules to pass the test
refactor: rewrite re rule to contains
versions.detection:
selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all: 'winget install'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -m '
        - ' --manifest '
condition: selection

versions.subject: Fix incorrectly formatted Winget LOLbin date
feat: updates and enhancements
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\winget.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'winget.exe'
selection_install_flag:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'install'
selection_manifest_flag:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-m '
        - '--manifest'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\winget.exe" OR OriginalFileName="winget.exe" CommandLine="*install*" CommandLine IN ("*-m *", "*--manifest*")

versions.subject: feat: update winget related rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\winget.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'winget.exe'
selection_install_flag:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'install'
        - ' add ' # https://github.com/microsoft/winget-cli/blob/02d2f93807c9851d73eaacb4d8811a76b64b7b01/src/AppInstallerCLICore/Commands/InstallCommand.h
selection_manifest_flag:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-m '
        - '--manifest'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\winget.exe" OR OriginalFileName="winget.exe" CommandLine IN ("*install*", "* add *") CommandLine IN ("*-m *", "*--manifest*")
